services.name: Netflix
services.quickAnswer: Sign in to Netflix in a web browser, go to the Manage your membership page, choose Cancel, then Finish Cancellation. You keep access until the end of the billing period. If there is no cancel option, you are billed by a partner such as Apple or your TV provider and must cancel with them.

steps.title: Open Manage your membership
steps.body: Sign in to Netflix in a web browser and go to the Manage your membership page. The TV app cannot cancel a membership.

steps.title: Choose Cancel
steps.body: Netflix may suggest a cheaper plan first. Skip it if you want to leave.

steps.title: Select Finish Cancellation
steps.body: Netflix emails a confirmation to your account address. Keep it as proof.

after: You keep access until the current billing period ends, then the account closes automatically.
Your viewing activity, ratings and account details are kept for 24 months, so restarting within that time restores them.
Signing out or deleting the app does not cancel your membership.

faq.q: Can I get a refund after cancelling Netflix?
faq.a: Netflix generally does not refund partial billing periods. Billing errors and unauthorized charges go through Netflix support.

faq.q: Why is there no Cancel button in my Netflix account?
faq.a: You are billed by a partner such as Apple, Google or your phone or TV provider. Your Account page shows who bills you and links to their cancel steps.

faq.q: Can I cancel Netflix on my TV?
faq.a: No. Use a web browser on any phone or computer.

services.name: Spotify Premium
services.quickAnswer: Sign in at spotify.com/account in a web browser, go to Manage your plan and select Cancel subscription. Premium stays until your next billing date, then your account switches to the free plan. No Cancel option means you are billed through a partner such as your phone or internet provider.

steps.title: Go to Manage your plan
steps.body: Sign in at spotify.com/account in a web browser and open Manage your plan.

steps.title: Select Cancel subscription
steps.body: Spotify may suggest a cheaper plan. Continue to cancel.

steps.title: Check the end date
steps.body: Premium stays on until your next billing date, then the account switches to free. No Cancel option? Check Payment on the same page to see which partner bills you.

after: Premium stays until your next billing date, then your account switches to free.
Cancelling during a free trial switches you to free right away, and the trial cannot be reactivated.
Your playlists and saved music stay on your free account.

faq.q: Where do I cancel Spotify Premium?
faq.a: On your account page in a web browser, under Manage your plan. If you subscribed through Apple in the iPhone app, cancel in your Apple subscriptions.

faq.q: Will I lose my playlists?
faq.a: No. Playlists and liked songs stay on your free account.

faq.q: How do I cancel a Family or Duo plan?
faq.a: Only the plan manager can cancel the whole plan. When a member follows the cancel steps, it removes them from the plan without cancelling it. After cancellation, everyone moves to the free plan from the next payment date.

services.name: Amazon Prime
services.quickAnswer: On Amazon, open Account & Lists, then Prime Membership. Choose Manage membership, then End membership, and keep confirming past the offer screens until Amazon shows the cancellation date.

steps.title: Open Prime Membership
steps.body: Go to Account & Lists, then Prime Membership. In the app, it is under Your Account.

steps.title: Choose Manage membership
steps.body: Then select End membership.

steps.title: Continue past the offers
steps.body: Amazon shows several screens with reminders and offers. Keep choosing the option to continue cancelling.

steps.title: Save the confirmation
steps.body: The final screen shows when Prime ends. Take a screenshot as proof.

after: Amazon may refund the current membership fee if you have not used Prime benefits in that period.
If you used benefits, Prime usually stays active until the end of the paid period.
Prime Video channels billed through Amazon are separate and must be cancelled on their own.

faq.q: Will Amazon refund my Prime fee?
faq.a: Amazon may refund part or all of the current fee if you have not used Prime benefits since it was charged. The cancel flow shows what applies to you.

faq.q: Does cancelling Prime cancel Prime Video channels?
faq.a: No. Channels such as Max or Paramount+ added through Prime Video are separate subscriptions. Cancel them under Memberships & Subscriptions.

faq.q: Why does Amazon keep showing offers?
faq.a: The cancel flow has several confirmation and offer screens. Your membership is only cancelled once you see the end date.

services.name: Hulu
services.quickAnswer: Sign in at hulu.com, open your Account page, choose Cancel under Your Subscription, and follow the prompts to confirm. If Hulu is billed through Apple, Google, Amazon or a bundle, cancel with that company.

steps.title: Sign in at hulu.com
steps.body: Use a browser and open your Account page from the profile menu.

steps.title: Find Your Subscription
steps.body: Select Cancel next to your plan.

steps.title: Continue past the pause offer
steps.body: Hulu may offer to pause instead. Choose to continue cancelling if you want to leave.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.body: Hulu shows the date your access ends.

after: You keep access until the end of your current billing period.
Add-ons like Live TV or premium channels end with the base plan.

faq.q: Can I pause Hulu instead of cancelling?
faq.a: Hulu offers a pause option for some plans. It is shown during the cancel flow.

faq.q: I have the Disney bundle. How do I cancel just Hulu?
faq.a: Bundles are managed by the company that bills you, often Disney+. Change or cancel the bundle there.

services.name: Disney+
services.quickAnswer: Sign in at disneyplus.com in a browser, open Account, select your subscription, choose Cancel Subscription and confirm. Billed through Apple, Google or Roku? Cancel there.

steps.title: Sign in at disneyplus.com
steps.body: Open your profile menu and select Account.

steps.title: Select your subscription
steps.body: Choose the Disney+ plan or bundle you want to end.

steps.title: Choose Cancel Subscription
steps.body: Confirm on the next screen.

steps.title: Check the end date
steps.body: Disney+ shows when access ends and emails a confirmation.

after: Access continues until the end of the period you paid for.
Cancelling a bundle ends every service in that bundle.

faq.q: Does Disney+ give refunds?
faq.a: Disney+ generally does not refund partial billing periods.

faq.q: Can I cancel Disney+ on my TV?
faq.a: Usually not. Use a web browser, or the app store that bills you.

services.name: YouTube Premium
services.quickAnswer: Go to youtube.com/paid_memberships, click Manage membership, then Deactivate, then Continue to cancel. Pick a reason and click Yes, cancel. Benefits continue until the end of the billing period. If you joined in the iPhone app, cancel through Apple instead.

steps.title: Go to youtube.com/paid_memberships
steps.body: Sign in with the Google account that pays for Premium.

steps.title: Click Manage membership
steps.body: Then click Deactivate.

steps.title: Click Continue to cancel
steps.body: YouTube may offer to pause instead.

steps.title: Pick a reason and click Yes, cancel
steps.body: Benefits continue until the end of the billing period.

after: Your paid membership benefits continue until the end of the billing period.
You will not be charged again unless you subscribe again.

faq.q: Does cancelling YouTube Premium cancel YouTube Music?
faq.a: Yes. YouTube Premium includes YouTube Music Premium, so both end together.

faq.q: Can I pause instead?
faq.a: Yes. YouTube lets you pause, cancel or resume a paid membership.

services.name: Audible
services.quickAnswer: Use your credits first: unused credits are lost at the end of your final billing cycle. Then, on audible.com in a browser, select your name, open Membership details, choose Cancel membership and Confirm cancellation. Deleting the app does not cancel. Billed through the App Store or Google Play? Cancel there.

steps.title: Spend your credits
steps.body: Unused credits are lost at the end of your final billing cycle. Books you already bought stay in your library.

steps.title: Open Membership details
steps.body: On audible.com in a browser, select your name in the top navigation, then Membership details.

steps.title: Select Cancel membership
steps.body: Audible may offer a pause or a discount. Continue if you want to cancel.

steps.title: Select Confirm cancellation
steps.body: Audible emails a confirmation. Keep it.

after: Titles you bought with credits or a card stay in your library.
Unused credits are lost at the end of your final billing cycle.
Titles downloaded from the Plus Catalog become locked.

faq.q: Do I keep my Audible books after cancelling?
faq.a: Yes. Titles you bought with credits or cash stay in your library.

faq.q: What happens to my unused credits?
faq.a: They are removed when the membership ends. Use them before you cancel.

faq.q: Can I cancel Audible in the app?
faq.a: No. Deleting the app does not cancel. Use audible.com in a browser, or the App Store or Google Play if they bill you.

services.name: ChatGPT Plus
services.quickAnswer: Log in to ChatGPT on the web, click your profile icon, open Settings, then Billing, and under Cancel plan select Cancel. Cancel at least 24 hours before your next billing date to avoid another charge. If you subscribed in the iPhone or Android app, cancel through Apple or Google instead.

steps.title: Log in to ChatGPT
steps.body: Use chatgpt.com in a web browser.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click your profile icon and choose Settings.

steps.title: Go to Billing
steps.body: Choose Billing to see your plan.

steps.title: Select Cancel
steps.body: Under Cancel plan, select Cancel and confirm. Do this at least 24 hours before your next billing date so you are not charged again.

after: Cancellation takes effect the day after your next billing date, so you can keep using your paid plan until then.
Subscription fees are non-refundable under OpenAI's policy. Refund requests have their own help article.
Subscriptions bought in the iOS or Android app must be cancelled through the App Store or Google Play.

faq.q: Will OpenAI refund my ChatGPT Plus payment?
faq.a: OpenAI's help center says subscription fees are non-refundable. It links to a separate article for refund requests.

faq.q: Why can't I find the cancel option on the web?
faq.a: You probably subscribed through Apple or Google in the mobile app. Cancel in that app store.

faq.q: I can't access my account email. Can I still cancel?
faq.a: Yes. OpenAI support can cancel for you if you give the account email, the last four digits of the card, and the date of your latest payment.

faq.q: Does deleting my ChatGPT account cancel Plus?
faq.a: Yes, deleting your account also cancels the subscription, but deletion is permanent.

services.name: Adobe Creative Cloud
services.quickAnswer: Sign in to your Adobe account, open Plans and payment, select Manage plan, then Cancel your plan, and continue to Confirm cancellation. Most plans get a full refund within 14 days of first purchase. On an annual plan paid monthly, cancelling later costs 50% of the remaining contract.

steps.title: Check your plan type
steps.body: Monthly, annual paid monthly, or annual prepaid. It decides the refund or fee.

steps.title: Select Manage plan
steps.body: Sign in to your Adobe account and find the plan in Plans and payment.

steps.title: Select Cancel your plan, then Continue to cancel
steps.body: Check the plan details, choose a reason and select Continue.

steps.title: Review and select Confirm cancellation
steps.body: Adobe shows any fee before you confirm. Cancel each plan separately if you have more than one.

after: Most plans get a full refund if you cancel within 14 days of the initial purchase.
Annual plans paid monthly: after 14 days, the fee is 50% of the remaining contract balance.
Annual prepaid plans are not refunded if you cancel before the year ends.
Paid apps keep working until the end of the current billing period.

faq.q: Is there a fee to cancel Adobe?
faq.a: On an annual plan paid monthly, cancelling after 14 days costs 50% of the remaining contract balance. Annual prepaid plans are not refunded after 14 days.

faq.q: How do I avoid the early termination fee?
faq.a: Cancel within 14 days of the initial purchase. Otherwise the fee depends on your plan type.

faq.q: What happens to my files?
faq.a: Paid apps and services keep working until the end of the billing period, and your free Adobe account stays active.

services.name: Planet Fitness
services.quickAnswer: Planet Fitness lists three ways to cancel: log in to the member portal on planetfitness.com, visit your home club in person, or mail a written request to your home club. To stop the billing on the 17th, the club must receive your request by the 10th. Policies vary by location.

steps.title: Log in to the member portal
steps.body: Use your account on planetfitness.com.

steps.title: Request cancellation
steps.body: Follow the prompts for your membership.

steps.title: Save the confirmation
steps.body: Keep it until your statements show billing has stopped.

steps.title: Go to your home club
steps.body: The club where you signed up, listed in your account.

steps.title: Ask the front desk to cancel
steps.body: Bring photo ID. Ask whether a minimum-term buyout fee applies.

steps.title: Get written confirmation
steps.body: Ask for a printed or emailed confirmation before you leave.

steps.title: Write a cancellation letter
steps.body: Include your full name, member number, home club and the date. Use our free letter generator.

steps.title: Mail it to your home club
steps.body: Certified mail gives you proof of delivery. Allow time to arrive before the 10th.

steps.title: Watch your next statement
steps.body: If you are charged again, contact the club with your proof of mailing.

after: To stop the monthly billing on the 17th, the club must receive your request by the 10th.
To avoid the annual fee, the request must arrive by the 25th of the prior month.
If you are still within a minimum contract term, a $58 buyout fee applies. Policies can vary by location.

faq.q: Can I cancel Planet Fitness online?
faq.a: Yes. Planet Fitness lists the member portal on its website as one way to cancel, alongside visiting your home club or mailing a request.

faq.q: Can I cancel Planet Fitness by phone?
faq.a: Planet Fitness does not list phone cancellation. Use the member portal, visit your home club, or mail a letter.

faq.q: When do I need to cancel to avoid the next charge?
faq.a: The club must receive your request by the 10th to stop that month's billing on the 17th, and by the 25th of the prior month to avoid the annual fee.

services.name: Microsoft 365
services.quickAnswer: Go to account.microsoft.com/services/microsoft365, select Cancel subscription (it may read Upgrade or Cancel), then select I don't want my subscription. If you see Turn on recurring billing instead, it already ends on the date shown. Bought through Apple, Google Play or a retailer? Cancel with them.

steps.title: Open your Microsoft 365 services page
steps.body: Go to account.microsoft.com/services/microsoft365 and sign in with the Microsoft account that bought the subscription.

steps.title: Select Cancel subscription
steps.body: The button may read Upgrade or Cancel. If it says Turn on recurring billing, the subscription already ends on the date shown.

steps.title: Review the offers
steps.body: The Please review section may list cheaper plans.

steps.title: Select I don't want my subscription
steps.body: It is at the bottom of the page.

after: Storage drops to the free allowance: 5 GB shared by OneDrive and Outlook.com attachments, plus 15 GB of Outlook.com mail storage.
If you are over the free allowance, you cannot upload, edit or sync new OneDrive files, or send and receive Outlook.com email.
Microsoft says it may delete your OneDrive and its files after 6 months over the limit.
On Family plans, the people you shared with also lose their extra storage.

faq.q: Will I get a refund for Microsoft 365?
faq.a: Not every cancellation is refunded. For subscriptions bought from Microsoft, cancel first, then check Microsoft's refund policy.

faq.q: What happens to my OneDrive files?
faq.a: They stay, but if you are over the free 5 GB you cannot add or edit files, and Microsoft may delete them after 6 months. Download or trim them first.

faq.q: I bought Microsoft 365 from Amazon or another store. How do I cancel?
faq.a: Contact that retailer, or Apple or Google if you subscribed in their app store.

services.name: Dropbox
services.quickAnswer: Log in at dropbox.com, click your avatar, choose Manage account, click Cancel plan at the bottom, pick a reason and confirm. Your account moves to the free Basic plan with 2 GB at the end of the billing cycle. No Cancel plan button means you bought it in a mobile app store.

steps.title: Open Manage account
steps.body: Log in at dropbox.com, click your avatar in the bottom-left corner and choose Manage account.

steps.title: Click Cancel plan
steps.body: It is at the bottom of the page. Not there? You bought through a mobile app store.

steps.title: Pick a reason and confirm
steps.body: Click Continue canceling or Confirm change and follow the prompts.

steps.title: Check the confirmation email
steps.body: Look for "Dropbox Plan will not renew" from no-reply@dropbox.com.

after: Your plan runs to the end of the billing cycle, then moves to Basic with 2 GB of storage.
Over 2 GB, you may be unable to sync, upload, share or preview files, and Dropbox may delete files you own to get under the limit.
Deleting the app or letting your card expire does not reliably stop charges.

faq.q: Will Dropbox delete my files?
faq.a: If you stay over the 2 GB Basic limit, Dropbox may delete files you own. Download or remove files before the plan ends.

faq.q: Why is there no Cancel plan button?
faq.a: You probably subscribed in the iPhone or Android app. Cancel through that app store.

faq.q: Can I cancel Dropbox by mail?
faq.a: Yes, Dropbox accepts mailed requests, but they take longer and charges made before processing are not refunded.

services.name: Apple App Store subscriptions
services.quickAnswer: On iPhone or iPad, open Settings, tap your name, tap Subscriptions, choose the subscription and tap Cancel Subscription. No cancel button usually means it is already cancelled. To avoid a trial renewing, cancel at least 24 hours before it ends.
after: The subscription stays active until the end of the period you paid for.
A red expiration message means it has already ended.

faq.q: I can't find the subscription in my Apple settings.
faq.a: Search your email for "receipt from Apple" to see which Apple Account pays for it. If there is no Apple receipt, another company bills you: check your card statement.

faq.q: Can I cancel a family member's subscription?
faq.a: No. The person whose Apple Account pays for it has to cancel.

faq.q: When should I cancel a free trial?
faq.a: At least 24 hours before the trial ends, or it may renew.

services.name: Google Play subscriptions
services.quickAnswer: Open play.google.com/store/account/subscriptions on your Android device, signed in to the Google Account that pays. Select the subscription, tap Cancel subscription and follow the prompts. Uninstalling the app does not cancel it.
after: Uninstalling the app does not cancel the subscription.
Make sure you are signed in to the Google Account that holds the subscription.

faq.q: Does uninstalling an app cancel its subscription?
faq.a: No. You have to cancel in Google Play.

faq.q: I don't see the subscription in Google Play.
faq.a: You may be signed in to a different Google Account, or the subscription is billed by Apple or the company directly.
